text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Pelabuhan Kuantan) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 3 September 2026.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Pelabuhan

Kuantan yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur-Fasa 2

yang bermula dari kilometer 263.796 di koordinat U 448093.167, T 590349.341

Grid Bentuk Benar Serong Ditepati (RSO) Geosentrik Datum Malaysia (GDM2000)

dan berakhir di kilometer 265.108 di koordinat U 449296.924, T 589741.360 Grid RSO

Geosentrik Datum Malaysia (GDM2000) Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur-Fasa 2, kedua-dua

jarak diukur dari kilometer 250.60 Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur-Fasa 2 termasuk Plaza Tol

Pelabuhan Kuantan dan jalan sambungannya dan berakhir di Had Sempadan

Penyenggaraan (HSP) di koordinat U 449775.026, T 591262.074 Grid RSO Geosentrik

Datum Malaysia (GDM2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA PERSIMPANGAN BERTINGKAT PELABUHAN KUANTAN

Dibuat 1 September 2026

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/3/2 Jld. 3; PN(PU2)391/JLD.56]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (KUANTAN PORT INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Kuantan Port

Interchange) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 3 September 2026.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Kuantan Port Interchange which is part

of the East Coast Expressway-Phase 2 commencing from kilometre 263.796

at coordinates N 448093.167, E 590349.341 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geocentric Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 265.108

at coordinates N 449296.924, E 589741.360 of the RSO Geocentric Datum of Malaysia

(GDM2000) Grid of the East Coast Expressway-Phase 2, both distances are measured

from kilometre 250.60 of the East Coast Expressway-Phase 2 including

the Kuantan Port Toll Plaza and its link roads and ending at the Limit of Maintenance

Responsibility (LMR) at coordinates N 449775.026, E 591262.074 of the RSO Geocentric

Datum of Malaysia (GDM2000) Grid, is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1)

is shown on the map in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]
